title: Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure
abstract: arXiv:2611.28135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE

translated_title: 超越输出抑制：通过视觉内在隐私擦除缓解大型视觉语言模型的隐私风险
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28135v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：大型视觉语言模型能够从图像中提取个人身份信息，这使得隐私保护对其在面向感知任务中的部署至关重要。现有的针对性微调和模型编辑方法通常通过将模型对齐到安全响应来抑制敏感答案。在本文中，我们证明了这种保护可能只是虚幻的：尽管微调后的模型在正常解码时会拒绝披露隐私信息，但在句子补全场景中隐私泄露依然会发生。这表明现有算法仅仅改变了模型的输出分布，而模型仍然保留着感知隐私信息的能力，因此隐私信息依然留存在模型内部。为解决这一问题，我们提出了视觉内在隐私擦除，该方法针对与隐私相关的视觉表征，以削弱模型感知敏感信息的能力。VIPE
tldr: 提出视觉内在隐私擦除方法VIPE，通过削弱模型对隐私相关视觉表征的感知能力，从根本上清除大型视觉语言模型内部残留的隐私信息，而非仅仅抑制其输出。
en_tdlr: Proposes Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to fundamentally erase private information retained within LVLMs, rather than merely suppressing their outputs.
